title: Budget and quota gateway
one_line: Cap spend and request rates per tenant before a model call goes out.
verified_against: Pure-Python gateway, quota store and retry logic tested in-process with injected fakes for every port. No real provider throttling or shared quota store was exercised.
snippet:
import asyncio
from briefcase.controls import FixedWindowQuotaStore, Gateway, GatewayConfig

gw = Gateway(GatewayConfig(
    quota_store=FixedWindowQuotaStore(),
    buckets={"chat": {"limit": 5, "window_s": 60.0}},
))
outcome = asyncio.run(gw.invoke(tenant_id="t1", bucket="chat", fn=lambda: "hi"))
print(outcome.ok, outcome.reason)
